extension.summary: Optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins: art colours, soft art, album spines, queue reordering and a genre wheel.
extension.description: An optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Each skin turns on only the features it uses, and every skin works fully without it. The features: the colours of the focused and the playing album's art, with a soft, blurred copy of the art to light the screen; a coloured spine for every album in the music library; reordering of the Up next queue; the library's genres, styles and moods with album counts, ready to play as a shuffled mix. While a skin that uses none of them is active, the helper stays idle. Album colours, soft art and spines use the Python Imaging Library (script.module.pil), which Kodi installs with it.
extension.disclaimer: Made for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Other skins can opt in; see the API notes in the source repository.
extension.news: 1.0.3 - Fix: two helper jobs saving the same file at the same moment could collide and show a "KarmaMole Skin Helper error" pop-up. Each save now uses its own temporary file and retries briefly if the file is busy. 1.0.2 - Fix: Kodi 21 could crash a few seconds after switching views while art colours were on (seen in Groove). The focused item's art is now read on Kodi's GUI thread (JSON-RPC XBMC.GetInfoLabels) instead of xbmc.getInfoLabel, which reads the view without a lock while Kodi swaps it. 1.0.1 - Fixes from the Kodi repository review: a failed library request no longer leaves the genre wheel and the spines empty until the library changes; Up next moves and removals are ignored once the music has stopped, instead of changing the wrong songs; cover loading uses its own temporary file per request; soft art still on screen is never pruned; refresh re-reads replaced covers; a skin switch stops a spine build at once; a shuffled mix of a very large folder says when only part of it was queued. 1.0.0 - First release as the shared KarmaMole Skin Helper (it was the Groove helper): art colours with soft art, album spines, Up next reordering, genre/style/mood wheel and true shuffle, each turned on per skin. Shuffled mixes are put in a random order by the helper, so Kodi's own shuffle setting is never changed.
